responsibility: Performs constant folding for calls to built-in and internal functions when their operands are compile-time constants. It evaluates library-like string and memory builtins, selected arithmetic/internal helper functions, and floating-point math functions via MPFR when target formats can be modeled exactly, returning folded tree constants or null when folding would be unsafe because of format limits, exceptions, NaNs, infinities, or rounding constraints.
same_name_distinction: Specializes the fold-const stem for constant folding of calls to built-in and internal functions, with string/memory builtin evaluation and MPFR-backed math-call folding; unlike gcc/fold-const.h and especially gcc/fold-const.cc, it handles call-specific folding logic rather than the general tree-folding API or broad expression simplifier.
